frame.text: In one short sentence, what can you help me with?

I can help with tasks across your connected tools — answering questions, running commands, taking photos with your glasses, scheduling work, and more (type /help for commands); also, want me to build a quick profile of you so I can tailor answers? Totally fine to skip or do it later. ▉
